findings.text: _mapped_region_count is monkeypatched in every test that exercises the trigger (tests/test_jax_config.py:126 and :141), so the one function the containment depends on is never run against a real /proc/self/maps; a regression in it (a wrong path, counting bytes instead of lines, returning 0 as it already does on any OSError) leaves tests/test_jax_config.py fully green while release_compilation_caches_when_mapped silently never fires.

the autouse fixture is the containment itself and nothing asserts it is registered or applied to this module's tests, so deleting it reddens no test short of the multi-hour arm; an assertion collected from this module (for example that the fixture name is in the item's fixturenames) would make the regression visible in the fast lane.

the before/after counts in the release assertion still come from the test's own stub iterator, so they pin the wiring (a re-read after the clear) rather than a measured reduction; the assertion reddens if the code stops re-reading the count, which is the regression it was added for, but it cannot show that a release drops anything.
